rick-rubin — what the tools print

Real output from the Time Crisis project, captured 2026-10-06 00:13. Each block is one command as an agent sees it.

Writing a song

song.py — the source

The song is Python the agent writes. An excerpt of Time Crisis.

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ drums
four = song.pattern("four", kick, "x...x...x...x...", desc="four on the floor")
four_gap = four.variant("four_gap", bars={1: "x...x...x......."}, desc="beat 4 left empty before a new phrase")
four_push = four.variant("four_push", bars={1: "x...x...x...x..o"}, desc="16th pickup into the next bar")

backbeat = song.pattern("backbeat", clap, "....x.......x...")
clap_turn = backbeat.variant("clap_turn", bars={1: "....x.......x.gx"}, desc="pickup into the next phrase")
clap_roll = song.pattern("clap_roll", clap,
                         "o.......o.......|o...o...o...o...|5.5.6.6.7.7.8.8.|8888999999XX....",
                         desc="half notes -> quarters -> 8ths -> 16ths, last beat silent")

hat_a = song.pattern("hat_a", hats, "g.xgo.x.g.xgo.xo|g.xgo.x.g.xgoxxg", desc="2 bars; the second ends on a 16th run")
hat_build = song.pattern("hat_build", hats, "x.o.x.o.x.o.x.o.|x.o.x.o.x.o.x.o.|xoxoxoxoxoxoxoxo|xxxxxxxxxxxx....",
                         desc="8ths that double up under the roll")
offbeat = song.pattern("offbeat", ohat, "..x...x...x...x.")
offbeat_turn = offbeat.variant("offbeat_turn", bars={1: "..x...x...x..ox."})
rim_talk = song.pattern("rim_talk", rim, "...x..x....x..x.|.o....x..x.o..x.", desc="call in bar 1, answer in bar 2")
hit = song.pattern("hit", crash, "X...............")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ bass (organ one-shot; never on a kick)
# Roots F - Db - Eb - C. The sparse line carries the groove section; the drop version adds
# the 16th pickups and octave pops on top of the same notes.
bass_a = song.pattern("bass_a", bass, [
    "1.3 F0 0.35; 2.3 F0 0.35 v108; 3.3 F0 0.35; 4.3 F1 0.3 v104",
    "1.3 Db1 0.35; 2.3 Db1 0.35 v108; 3.3 Db1 0.35; 4.4 Ab0 0.2 v96",

# BS Gunman Reese [Sam Smyers] — Serum 2 preset
by Sam Smyers · tags: Wavetable, Mono · "Interplanetary Criminal, Riko Dan"
(values are Serum's own units; anything not listed is at its init value)

## Oscillators
- OSC A ON  wavetable 'Default Shapes' (RandomPhase 0, TablePos 128); Detune 0.142, Fine -25, Octave -2, UnisonStereo 0.76, Volume 0.72
- OSC B ON  wavetable 'Default Shapes' (RandomPhase 0, TablePos 136); Fine 25, Octave -2, Volume 0.72
- OSC C ON  wavetable 'Default Shapes'; Detune 0.188, Octave -2, Unison 3, UnisonStereo 0, Volume 1
- SUB ON  Octave -2, Volume 0

## Filters
- FILTER 1: Enable 1, Freq 0.494, Reso 1.72, Type LH12, Var 50.7
- FILTER 2: Drive 25, Enable 1, Freq 0.699, Reso 37.4
- routing: OSC B → RoutingDest RoutingDestFilter; OSC C → FilterBalance 100, RoutingDest RoutingDestFilter

## Envelopes and LFOs (ENV 1 is the amp envelope)
- LFO 1: Rate 10.7

## FX (in order; 'Wet 0' units are switched in by a macro if one targets them)
- Phaser: Depth 37.1, Depth2 0, Freq 119, NumPoles 3, Rate 0.476, Wet 0, Width 0
- Distortion: Mode Diode2, Wet 0
- Chorus: Delay 3.22, Delay2 0.844, Feedback 14.4, Filt 10304, Rate 0.0661, Wet 0
- Reverb: Delay 35.6, Feedback 22.1, Freq 16.3, FreqB 13.5, Size 34.9, Type Hall, Wet 0, Width 32.8

## Macros (what the eight knobs do)
- Macro 1 'FILTER 1' at 50% → VoiceFilter0.Freq +29; VoiceFilter0.Var +29
- Macro 2 'FILTER 2' at 50% → VoiceFilter1.Freq +52
- Macro 3 'DETUNE' → Oscillator0.Fine +13; Oscillator1.Fine -11; Oscillator2.Detune -17
- Macro 4 'CHORUS' → FXChorus2.Wet +100
- Macro 5 'GLIDE' at 100% → Global0.PortamentoTime +38
- Macro 6 'SQUARE -> SAW' → WTOsc0.TablePos -52; WTOsc1.TablePos -55
- Macro 7 'DISTO PHASER' → FXPhaser0.Wet +76; FXDistortion1.Wet +76; FXDistortion1.LevelOut -5
- Macro 8 'REVERB' → FXReverb3.Wet +35

## Global
- MasterVolume 0.412, MonoToggle 1, PortaAlways 1
